hints.content:
We are trying to find a **unit rate**, specifically the distance, in kilometers, per $1$ hour.

$\dfrac{\blueE{\text{distance}}}{\maroonD{\text{hours}}} = \purpleD{\text{km per hour}}$

We can compare from the largest to the smallest place value.

###Finding the unit rates

We divide based on the unit rate we want, not the order of the columns in the original table.

Adventure| $\blueE{\text{Distance}}$ || $\maroonD{\text{Duration}}$||$\purpleE{\text{Average speed}}$ $(\text{km/h})$ 
- | :-: | :-:| :-:|:-:|:-:
High Tide |$3$|$\div$ | $1$|$=$|$3$
Monsoon|$5$ |$\div$ |$2$ | $=$|$2.5$
Tsunami |$14$ |$\div$ | $4$|$=$| $3.5$

###Comparing the unit rates

Adventure | Ones | $.$ | Tenths
- | :-: | :-:| :-:|:-:|:-:
High Tide | $3$ | $.$ | $0$
Monsoon| $\redE{2}$ | $.$ | $5$
Tsunami |  $3$ | $.$ | $5$

The Monsoon adventure travels the fewest ones of kilometers per hour.

###Conclusion

Monsoon offers the lowest average speed.
